tools.name: search_oqda
tools.description: Full-text search over all pages of oqda.de (modules, features, pricing, industries, comparison, company, legal). Returns the best matching pages with URL and snippet; read a page in full with get_page. Content is German, so German search terms work best (e.g. "Dienstplan", "Zeiterfassung", "Praxis",

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: Returns one page of oqda.de as Markdown. Pass a path or URL, e.g. "/", "/module/dienstplan/", "/module/termine/buchungsseite/", "/branchen/praxen/", "/preise/", "/vergleich/", "/ueber-uns/", "/datenschutz/". list_modules and search_oqda return valid paths.

tools.name: list_modules
tools.description: Lists all eight oqda modules (Dienstplan, Termine, Team, Prozesse, KI-Agent, Marketing, Lernen, Controlling) with their features, individual prices and page URLs, plus the platform core included in every module.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Returns oqda pricing: packages (Single, Multi, Enterprise) per location and month, individual module prices, conditions (no setup fee, cancel monthly, no per-user pricing) and usage-based costs. Prices in EUR, excluding VAT, for businesses only.

tools.name: compare_alternatives
tools.description: Explains how oqda differs from running separate tools (roster spreadsheet, booking calendar, chat groups, learning platform, reporting): which tool each oqda feature replaces, how the modules work together, what it costs, and when oqda is NOT a fit (no patient records, no LIMS, no SMS, no payroll).

tools.name: join_waitlist
tools.description: Puts a person on the oqda waitlist (free and non-binding; oqda contacts them personally when a spot opens, then they decide). tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Forwards a question or request from the person to the oqda team (e.g. whether oqda fits their business, an Enterprise offer for 11+ locations, a data protection request). The team replies personally by e-mail. Only send on behalf of the person, with their own e-mail address.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_oqda, get_page, list_modules · Private data: compare_alternatives, join_waitlist · Public sink: compare_alternatives, send_message.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_oqda, get_page, list_modules · Private data: compare_alternatives, join_waitlist · Public sink: compare_alternatives, send_message

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
